name: Espressif ESP32 (classic, Xtensa LX6)

flash_psram_gpio.notes: GPIO6-11 connect to SPI flash on all modules (DevKitC footnote: 'Avoid using these pins'). On ESP32-WROVER modules and chips with in-package PSRAM (e.g. ESP32-D0WDR2-V3) GPIO16/17 are reserved for PSRAM; on WROOM/SOLO they are free. ESP32-U4WDH / in-package flash parts use six GPIOs internally (datasheet 2-5).

usb_note: No native USB; boards use a USB-UART bridge on UART0.

adc2_wifi_conflict.note: ADC2 can't be used while Wi-Fi is on (ESP-IDF ADC docs). Digital use is fine.
adc2_wifi_conflict.approx_note: Not quoted from the chip datasheet text; from ESP-IDF ADC documentation.

caution_gpio.0: strapping: boot mode; BOOT button on most boards
caution_gpio.2: strapping: boot mode (must be low/floating for download)
caution_gpio.12: strapping MTDI: flash voltage (VDD_SDIO). High at reset on a 3.3V-flash module = boot failure
caution_gpio.15: strapping MTDO: ROM log + SDIO timing
caution_gpio.16: PSRAM on WROVER/in-package-PSRAM parts; free on WROOM (kept caution: photo can't always tell)
caution_gpio.17: PSRAM on WROVER/in-package-PSRAM parts; free on WROOM (kept caution)

chip_level.G{n}: GPIOn on many clones (but a bare 'G' is GND)
chip_level.{n}: bare number next to a header = GPIOn on Espressif DevKits
chip_level.BOOT: button on the boot strapping GPIO

board_level.D{n}: Arduino/XIAO-style digital number. NOT GPIOn on XIAO or Arduino Nano ESP32; look up the board's own map
board_level.SDA / SCL: board/framework default I2C, board-specific (ESP32 can route I2C to almost any GPIO)

never_map: D0..D3 printed next to CLK/CMD on classic ESP32 DevKitC = flash pins, NOT Arduino D0-D3

provenance.notes: Strapping GPIO0/2/MTDI(12)/MTDO(15)/GPIO5 and input-only 34-39 quoted from datasheet section 3 / IO_MUX notes.
